smokeping_url_hint: Base URL of your Smokeping instance (without /cache/)
smokeping_targets_hint: Comma-separated Smokeping hierarchy paths (e.g. InternetSites.Google). Check your Smokeping Targets config for the exact names.
smokeping_setup_intro: Smokeping measures network latency by sending pings to configured targets. DOCSight can display these graphs alongside your modem data.
smokeping_setup_step_1: Install and configure Smokeping on your network
smokeping_setup_step_2: Note the base URL of your Smokeping web interface
smokeping_setup_step_3: Enter the URL and target names in DOCSight Settings
smokeping_setup_guided_intro: Connect an existing SmokePing target to compare latency history with DOCSIS signal and outage evidence.
smokeping_setup_benefit_1: See long-term latency and packet loss trends
smokeping_setup_benefit_2: Correlate external symptoms with modem health
smokeping_setup_benefit_3: Use graphs as supporting ISP evidence
smokeping_setup_requirement_target: At least one configured target graph
smokeping_setup_configure_text: Save the SmokePing base URL and target name in Settings.
smokeping_setup_validate_text: After saving the endpoint, validate that DOCSight can discover target graphs.
smokeping_setup_validation_path: SmokePing validation depends on the saved base URL and target in SmokePing settings. Save those values first, then refresh this view to confirm live data.
smokeping_empty_text: Add the targets from your SmokePing configuration in the settings to show their latency graphs here.
